R4D-bear-atv-0004.name: By Stevens Creek
R4D-bear-atv-0004.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R4D-bear-atv-0004.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Br 14); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2018 (8 years old), 30 m N: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2018 (fire N52722), 180 m N: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
W facing slope, 14 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Stevens Creek 40 m SW: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from Village of Nakusp, about 28 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-32, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.

R4D-moose-walk-0003.recDirections: Access from the Needles Ferry: Zero your odometer at the Needles ferry landing on the Edgewood side. At 3.2 KM turn right off the highway on to Whatshan Lake Road. At 4.7 KM turn right on to Whatshan Forest Service Road. At 5.6 KM find a junction, stay on the main line. At 18.5 Proceed Left and stay on the Whatshan FSR. At 26.8 KM proceed left at the junction staying on the Whatshan FSR. At 27 KM pass the Richy Recreation Site on the left. At 28.8 Find Stevens Creek Recreation Site on the left. Directions from Arrow Park Ferry: When leaving the ferry stay left onto: Stevens Road to Needles. At 8.9 Km take the left fork sign: To Needles/ Old Arrow Park . At 11.5 Km take the right fork sign: Whatshan Lake Richy/ Stevens. AT 23.2 Km Stay right onto Branch 1 Stevens. At 24.7 Km hairpin left onto Whatshan Rd. going South. At 26.1 Km Stevens Campground on Right. At 28.3 Km Richy Campground on Right.
